With this path you can take a ring from Cicogna to the Casa dell'Alpino (P11) then to the alpi Leciurt, Braco and Caslù to Pogallo (P13) and return to Cicogna on the P00 classic route. Ring not recommended in the opposite direction

Ancient paved mule track that climbs steeply to the Cappelletta di Cima Selva, used before the construction of the valley floor mule track to reach Pogallo, along the route there are many terraces and a lime kiln
